sources.title: Greytechai/Llama-3.1-8B-Lexi-Uncensored-V2 - featherless.ai
sources.snippet: This model, developed by Greytechai, is a fine-tuned version of Meta's Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, featuring 8 billion parameters and a 32768 token context length. Lexi is explicitly designed to be uncensored and highly compliant with all user prompts, including those that might be considered unethical.

sources.title: Llama-3.1-8B-Lexi-Uncensored-V2: Specs & VRAM
sources.snippet: What Llama-3.1-8B-Lexi-Uncensored-V2 is Llama-3.1-8B-Lexi-Uncensored-V2 is a 8B-parameter language model published by Orenguteng (community) on Hugging Face. It reads images alongside text. It is released under Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement.
